as two mining projects, was the highest quarterly total in Fluor&#8217;s history and grew backlog 21% to $34.3 billion, building a solid foundation for sustained growth. Adjusted EBITDA guidance excludes items similar to those outlined in the reconciliation table at the end of this release.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:200%;text-decoration:underline">Conference Call</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:174%">Fluor will host a conference call at 8&#58;30 a.m. Eastern on Friday, November 6, which will be webcast live and can be accessed at </font><font style="color:#0e32e1;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:174%;text-decoration:underline">investor.fluor.com</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:174%">. In the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, consolidated segment profit includes the gain on sale of our interest in ICA-Fluor.</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:12.03pt">Consolidated segment margin is a ratio of consolidated segment profit (loss) to GAAP revenue. </font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:12.03pt">Adjusted net earnings (loss) is calculated as net earnings (loss) from core operations excluding equity method earnings and the impacts of foreign exchange fluctuations, impairments and certain items that management believes are unrelated to actual normalized operational performance. Net earnings (loss) from core operations is net earnings (loss) attributable to Fluor excluding the results of our Stork business that has now been divested.</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:12.03pt">Adjusted EPS is calculated as adjusted net earnings (loss) divided by weighted average diluted shares outstanding.</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:12.03pt">Adjusted EBITDA is calculated as net earnings from operations before interest, income taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), further adjusted by the same items excluded from adjusted net earnings. </font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:12.03pt">Adjusted EBITDA margin is a ratio of adjusted EBITDA to GAAP revenue.</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:12.03pt">Adjusted net revenue is calculated by reducing GAAP revenue to exclude at-cost revenue associated with reimbursable contracts for the following elements, where applicable&#58;</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#9702;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:13.9pt">amounts associated with unaffiliated subcontractor project costs that are billed to clients without meaningful markup&#59;</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#9702;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:13.9pt">amounts associated with costs of material that are billed to clients without meaningful markup&#59; and</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#9702;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:13.9pt">costs of customer-furnished materials that are procured by our clients and which do not give rise to meaningful markup to our billings to clients.</font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%;padding-left:12.03pt">Excluding the amounts of at-cost revenue from both GAAP revenue and from project cost yields an amount that we call adjusted net margin.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">We believe that consolidated segment profit (loss) provides a meaningful perspective on our business results as it is the aggregation of individual segment profit measures that we use to evaluate and manage our business performance. We believe adjusted net earnings, adjusted EPS and adjusted EBITDA allow investors to evaluate our ongoing earnings on a normalized basis and make meaningful period-over-period comparisons. In addition, we also measure our performance by analyzing trends in adjusted net revenue and related margin. At-cost revenue is generally reflected in our project estimates at equivalent amounts within the revenue and cost elements. Therefore, we believe our adjusted net revenue represents the basis for which we earn fees for our professional services. Others in our industry may have similar terms that they use to similarly measure the earnings power of their services. Even though our involvement with at-cost revenue elements as a principal gives rise to their inclusion in our </font></div><div style="height:45.36pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:139%">4</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:36pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div><div><font><br></font></div></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">consolidated revenue, the absence of meaningful markup to them elevates the importance of this non-GAAP analysis.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:145%">We provide non-GAAP measures to supplement GAAP measures, as they provide additional insight into our financial results. However, non-GAAP measures have limitations as analytical tools and should not be considered in isolation from or a substitute for measures of financial performance prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. In addition, these non-GAAP measures are not necessarily comparable to similarly titled measures reported by other companies. Reconciliations of our non-GAAP measures to the most comparable GAAP measures are included in the press release tables. The company is unable to provide a reconciliation of its adjusted EPS and adjusted EBITDA guidance to the most comparable GAAP measure without unreasonable efforts because it is unable to predict with reasonable certainty all of the components required to provide such reconciliation, including the impact of foreign exchange fluctuations, which are uncertain and could have a material impact on GAAP reported results for the guidance period.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:232%;text-decoration:underline">About Fluor Corporation</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:150%">Fluor Corporation (NYSE&#58; FLR) is building a better world by applying world-class expertise to solve its clients&#8217; greatest challenges. Fluor&#8217;s nearly 23,500 employees provide professional and technical solutions that deliver safe, well-executed, capital-efficient projects to clients around the world. Fluor had revenue of $15.5 billion in 2025 and is ranked 292 among the Fortune 500 companies. With headquarters in Irving, Texas, Fluor has provided engineering, procurement and construction services for more than a century.
